links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to breast cancer treatment questions against oncologist scoring
links.effect: Accuracy of the three models on breast cancer treatment questions was lowest, averaging 44.4%; overall about 57-67% comprehensive answers per model.
links.quote: The accuracy of the three models in answering questions regarding breast cancer treatment was the lowest, with an average of 44.4%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and readability of three LLMs answering breast cancer queries; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
